description: Configuration schema for IBM Verify Identiy Access

mgmt_base_url.description: The URL used to connect to the IVIA management interface. This can also be set via an environment property.

mgmt_user.description: The administrator account which will be used to apply the defined configuration. This can also be set via an environment property.

mgmt_pwd.description: The secret used to authenticate as the provided administrator account. This can be either a password or an access token. If an access token is set, then the `mgmt_user` property must not be defined. This can also be set via an environment property.

mgmt_old_pwd.description: If a password change for the provided admin account is required, this is the current password for that account, which will be updated to `mgmt_pwd` as part of the configuration steps. This can also be set via an environment property.
